'''Vodal Kressh''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who lived a thousand years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
A descendant of [[Ludo Kressh]], Vodal was an [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Alchemist]] who was considered to be the greatest in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]. However, as his madness and power grew, he rebelled against the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and fled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] which would become his final resting place. Even after his [[Death/Legends|death]] and [[Burial/Legends|burial]], many of his rebellious servants remained on the planet and their [[Tomb Dwellers|descendants]] occupied Vodal Kressh's tomb until they were [[Mission to Athiss|wiped out]] by a strike team during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] a thousand years later.<ref name="Athiss Flashpoint">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Athiss}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] thousands of years later, it was rumored that the Republic had destroyed Kressh and his followers, but that a dark cult still protected his tomb.<ref name="FaD CRB">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
